name: KromiumNavigation
description: Facade for browser navigation operations. Provides URL loading with lifecycle stage awaiting, history traversal, HTML injection, network idle detection, and reload/stop controls.
whenToUse: Access via browser.navigation to load URLs, navigate history, wait for page lifecycle stages, or detect network idle state.

properties.name: navigationState
properties.description: Observable state stream of the browser's navigation and loading status.

methods.name: loadUrl
methods.signature: suspend fun loadUrl(url: String, waitUntil: NavigationStage = NavigationStage.LOADED, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): Boolean
methods.description: Loads a specific URL in the browser and suspends until the navigation reaches the requested stage.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to load.

parameters.name: waitUntil
parameters.description: The lifecycle stage to await (default: LOADED).

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds.

methods.name: loadUrl
methods.description: Loads a specific URL in the browser without suspending.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to load.

methods.name: loadUrlAsync
methods.signature: fun loadUrlAsync(url: String, waitUntil: NavigationStage = NavigationStage.LOADED, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Loads a specific URL and returns a CompletableFuture that completes when the requested stage is reached.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to load.

parameters.name: waitUntil
parameters.description: The lifecycle stage to await (default: LOADED).

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds.

methods.name: waitForNavigation
methods.signature: suspend fun waitForNavigation(stage: NavigationStage = NavigationStage.LOADED, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): Boolean
methods.description: Waits for the page navigation lifecycle to reach the specified stage.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: The lifecycle stage to await.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds.

methods.name: waitForNavigationAsync
methods.signature: fun waitForNavigationAsync(stage: NavigationStage = NavigationStage.LOADED, timeoutMs: Long = 10_000L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Waits for the page navigation lifecycle to reach the specified stage and returns a CompletableFuture.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: The lifecycle stage to await.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds.

methods.name: waitForNetworkIdle
methods.signature: suspend fun waitForNetworkIdle(idleTimeMs: Long = 500L, maxTimeoutMs: Long = 10_000L, pollIntervalMs: Long = 50L): Boolean
methods.description: Waits until there are no active in-flight network requests for a specific duration.

parameters.name: idleTimeMs
parameters.description: The continuous duration (in ms) that network requests must be at zero.

parameters.name: maxTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait before giving up.

parameters.name: pollIntervalMs
parameters.description: The frequency to check the network state (in ms).

methods.name: waitForNetworkIdleAsync
methods.signature: fun waitForNetworkIdleAsync(idleTimeMs: Long = 500L, maxTimeoutMs: Long = 10_000L, pollIntervalMs: Long = 50L): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Waits until there are no active in-flight network requests and returns a CompletableFuture.

parameters.name: idleTimeMs
parameters.description: The continuous duration (in ms) that network requests must be at zero.

parameters.name: maxTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait before giving up.

parameters.name: pollIntervalMs
parameters.description: The frequency to check the network state (in ms).

methods.name: loadHtml
methods.description: Loads raw HTML content directly into the browser.

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: The raw HTML string.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A dummy URL to use as the origin/base (default is "http://kromium.local/").

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates backwards in the history, if possible.

methods.name: goForward
methods.description: Navigates forwards in the history, if possible.

methods.name: canGoBack
methods.description: Returns true if the browser can navigate backwards.

methods.name: canGoForward
methods.description: Returns true if the browser can navigate forwards.

parameters.name: ignoreCache
parameters.description: Whether to bypass the cache when reloading.

methods.name: stopLoad
methods.description: Stops any pending or current load operation.
